claims.quote: The Madagascar panchax, Pachypanchax sakaramyi, is a killifish from high-gradient forest streams around the Ambohitra Massif in northern Madagascar.
Pachypanchax sakaramyi originates from the Sakaramy River on Madagascar.

regions.name: Sakaramy River
regions.quote: The only remaining riverine populations are in a short stretch of the Sakaramy River and the upper Antongombato River, most of the original populations having been lost to invasive species, deforestation and the diversion of the Sakaramy's source.
